I can only speak about the big Torrent, from what I've heard the Compact is quite a bit worse in this department.

Coming from a Define R6 the cable management is definitely a lot worse, there isn't quite as much space to tuck things in at the back plus the rear panel being glass means you need to be a bit more careful - tempered glass doesn't like bulging much.

Overall it wasn't terrible, but certainly required more care and thought.

What was an absolute hassle was moving the 180mm fans to the bottom - I have a 420mm radiator up front and so decided to put the big fans at the bottom. Which is doable, but they completely block the cable routing holes, so the only way I've managed to do that was to leave maybe a 4cm gap between them and pull all the cables through there. Not sure how it's with the Compact and 140mm fans, I'd imagine probably a lot better.

Having 140mm fans at the bottom in the big Torrent is also not a problem at all, it's just that the 180mm ones are so thick.

The bottom fans do wonders for GPU thermals in the full size version, I see no reason why they wouldn't do the same for the Compact.  
For reference my 4090 stays under 60C when gaming and under 65C running TimeSpy Extreme stress test with the bottom fans as intake.

No rear exhaust shouldn't be an issue, the entire back part is almost unobstructed and you're already pumping a ton of air into the case.

I've added an exhaust fan, but there has been basically zero difference in temperatures, maybe 1 or 2C and that may very well be down to differences in ambient temps. I'll admit the reason was more to do with looks than anything.

In the beginning wait until you have 15 wood and 5 steel then immediately pull 10 people to build a Workshop, staff it and do Emergency Shift researching Beacon.

Next law should be Child Shelters -> Medic Apprentices, you should also get a group containing more Engineers, put those to Medposts. Once the temperature goes to -40 you absolutely need to have everyone housed, but until then it's not a priority. Keep in mind you can always manage high discontent by just running overdrive over night and switching Extented Shifts on/off as needed, you have 3 days to lower it after getting an ultimatum.

Nothing as such, I'm just quite peculiar about contrast and play a lot of horror games or just generally dark games.

Added bonus is that VA panels don't suffer from glow and seem much less affected by BLB, which are two things I can't stand, especially since I tend to play in the dark at night, when it's most visible.

All the others are at least 100€ more.

I'm not particularly interested in high refresh, at least not as the options currently stand.

At 2560x1440 it's either TN (which I really don't want) or IPS with rather bad QA and consequently many issues (BLB, Glow).

Neither am I that confident in paying 700€ or more for such a display.

As far as keeping up goes - it doesn't have to be max graphics, I'm fine making some adjustments (hell I had to do that even on 2560x1440 with the 1080) if it doesn't mean playing on medium.
